we present the first CNN that is small enough to fit entirely in the on-chip memory of an FPGA, and still achieve AlexNet-level accuracy.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have developed a small DNN that is 50 times smaller than AlexNet in terms of parameters and is 510 times smaller in terms of model size.
SqueezeNet is a 2.4x smaller model with 50x less parameters than AlexNet and yet it achieves similar top-5 error.
SqueezeNet provides AlexNet-level accuracy, but with 50-100 times fewer parameters and less than 0,5MB model size (AlexNet has 242MB model size).

it is possible to design a small DNN that achieves AlexNet-level classification accuracy.
a small DNN does not need to sacrifice accuracy to provide the aforementioned advantages.
